scripts.text:
[Airship Crew]
If we've landed at
your destination and
you'd like to leave the
Airship, please use the
stairs up ahead. Thank
you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇船员]
如果我们已经抵达了您的目的地，而您想要离开飞空艇，请使用前方的楼梯。感谢您的光临。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Wow, mom!
L-look at this!
We're flying! W-we're...
We're in the freakin' sky!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哇，妈妈！
快——快看这个！
我们在飞！我——我们……
我们在天空中飞啊！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Makumalagu!
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo.
Bwahahahahahahaah!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
Makumalagu!
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo.
Bwahahahahahahaah!

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Shush...
Honey, behave~
Don't act so excited
when we're out in a
public place like this!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
嘘……
宝贝，乖一点~
在公共场合不要这么兴奋！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Chooktu!
Sacraup matii!
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
Chooktu!
Sacraup matii!
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo!

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Hey there~
From that look on
your face, I see that
you can understand
me. ^333333*Whew...!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
嘿~
看你的表情，我觉得你一定能听懂我在说什么。 ^333333*呼……！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
I've been helping the
Airship enterprise by
having the Airship Crewmen
train in Umbala to overcome
any acrophobia they might have through bungee jumping. Neat, eh?
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
我一直在为飞空艇事业出一份力。我让飞空艇船员们在汶巴拉接受训练，通过蹦极来克服可能存在的恐高症。很酷吧？

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
But...
Some of them couldn't
overcome their fear of
heights. And a few even
ended up, um, ^333333in Niflheim^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
但是……
他们中有些人还是没能克服恐高症。甚至还有几个人，呃，^333333去了尼福尔海姆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona 
salu. Dama, kookoo na nu
yukuta. Um, fashuku na ret!
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona 
salu. Dama, kookoo na nu
yukuta. Um, fashuku na ret!

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎乘坐
飞空艇。请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Do you have a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 有一位名叫蒂埃里的乘客吗？

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
I am sorry, but I do not think that we have a passenger by that name.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
很抱歉，我想我们这里并没有叫这个名字的乘客。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎乘坐
飞空艇。请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Using the Airship
scripts.translation: 乘坐飞空艇

scripts.text: Captain's Cabin
scripts.translation: 船长室

scripts.text: Facilities
scripts.translation: 设施

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
When you see a broadcast
announcing that we have
arrived at your destination,
please use one of the exits
located at the north and
south ends of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
当您听到广播宣布我们已抵达目的地时，请使用位于飞空艇南北两端的出口之一。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
If you happen to miss
your stop, don't worry.
The Airship is constantly
en route and you'll get
another chance to arrive
to your intended destination.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
如果您不小心错过了站点，请不要担心。飞空艇会不断运行，您之后还会有机会抵达预定的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Captain's Cabin
is located at the front
of the Airship. There, you
can meet the captain and
the pilot of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
船长室位于
飞空艇的前端。
在那里，你可以见到
飞空艇的船长和飞行员。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Airship provides
various Mini Games for
the entertainment of all
our passengers. We invite
you to try your luck and skills
in the Airship's Mini Games~
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
为了让所有乘客
都能尽情娱乐，
飞空艇提供了各种小游戏。
我们邀请您来飞空艇的小游戏中
挑战运气与技巧~

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Well, I hope you
your flight aboard
our Airships. Thank
you and have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
祝您在我们的
飞空艇上
飞行愉快。谢谢，
祝您度过美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Zerta]
Oh, hello adventurer.
I am currently on a
sacred journey, offering
prayer for the sake of the
Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[泽塔]
噢，你好，冒险者。
我目前正在进行一场
神圣的旅程，为
米德加尔特大陆
祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Maelin]
Um, this Airship is
to Lutie, isn't it? I've
waiting so long,
but I haven't heard any
broadcast about Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[梅琳]
嗯，这艘飞空艇是
去往姜饼城的，对吧？
我已经等了很久了，
但还没听到任何关于
姜饼城的广播。

scripts.text:
[Aanos]
Oh wooow~
The sky looks
so different and
pretty from up there!
scripts.translation:
[阿诺斯]
噢，哇哦~
从上面看，
天空看起来
如此不同且美丽！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
I wish that I could go drink a cold fresh beer.
Drinking is the goal of my life! Drinking gives me energy!
I am nothing without drinks!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
真希望我能去喝杯冰凉清爽的啤酒。
喝酒是我人生的目标！喝酒能给我力量！
没有酒我就什么都不是！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
But! Driving under the influence is not good.
But! That makes me want to drink more and more!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
但是！酒后驾车是不好的。
但是！这反而让我越来越想喝酒了！

scripts.text: Do you know a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 你知道一位名叫蒂埃里的乘客吗？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
这身制服
看起来很帅气，
但在飞空艇上穿起来
实在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer. I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
...
......
根本没有人会
真的进这个房间。
而且船长确实是一头驯鹿。我可以直接脱到只剩内裤。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Wah!? Who is it!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
哇！？是谁！

scripts.text: - ...He is not listening to you, at all. -
scripts.translation: - ...他根本没在听你说话。 -

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
It's been sooo
long since I've
enjoyed a nice, cold
alcoholic brew. But the
job requires me to be as
clear headed as I can!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
我已经好久好久
没有享用过一杯
冰凉美味的酒精饮料了。
但工作要求我必须
保持头脑清醒！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Always drink responsibly!
Still, I can't remember the
last time I had a real vacation
or even a day off. Yeap, some
booze, some chips, some TV
and serious R&R is in order.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
一定要适量饮酒！
话虽如此，我都不记得
上次真正休假或休息
是什么时候了。没错，得来点
烈酒、薯片、看电视，
然后好好放松一下。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Man, the weather
is really nice today.
Bright, open skies make
for some good visibility
and safe, carefree flying.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
伙计，今天的天气
真的很棒。
晴朗开阔的天空
带来了良好的能见度，
让飞行既安全又无忧无虑。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, our captain's a
respectable guy. Him and
his brother are actually well
known in the aircraft industry.
Who knew reindeer made
such good captains?
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
你知道吗，我们的船长是位
受人尊敬的人。他和
他的兄弟在航空界
其实很有名。
谁能想到驯鹿能成为
这么优秀的船长呢？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Just between you
and me, I gotta tell
you, that Santa was onto
something, getting reindeers
and elves to work for him.
The man must be a genius!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
悄悄告诉你，
我觉得圣诞老人
很有眼光，竟然能让
驯鹿和精灵为他工作。
那家伙一定是天才！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, this whole
piloting thing in the air,
it's rather new, you know?
Yeah, they got this Airship
operation in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
你知道，这种在空中
驾驶飞空艇的事情，
其实还挺新鲜的，对吧？
没错，他们匆忙
开始了飞空艇的运营。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Still, they were real
serious, really thought
ahead. I mean, they had us
training while the Airships
were still being invented.
Isn't that freakin' crazy?!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
不过，他们真的很认真，
考虑得很周全。我的意思是，
在飞空艇还在研发阶段时，
他们就让我们进行训练了。
这难道不觉得疯狂吗？！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Welcome to Fruitz's
Shop where you can
purchase Apples or grind
them to make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
欢迎来到弗鲁茨的
商店。在这里你可以
购买苹果，或者将它们
榨成苹果汁。

scripts.text: Buy Apples.
scripts.translation: 购买苹果

scripts.text: Make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation: 制作苹果汁

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Please enter the amount
of Apples that you wish to
buy. Each Apple is 15 zeny
and you can buy a maximum
of 500 at a time. Please enter
 '0' to cancel your order.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
请输入你想购买的
苹果数量。每个苹果
售价 15 泽尼，每次
最多可购买 500 个。
请输入 '0' 取消订单。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的商店。
再见！想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
You've entered a number
higher than the maximum
value of 500. Please enter
the number of Apples you
wish to purchase again.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
你输入的数字超过了
500 的最大值。
请重新输入你想购买的
苹果数量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
A total of ^FF0000{0}^000000 Apples
will cost you ^FF0000{1}^000000 zeny.
Would you like to continue?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
总计 ^FF0000{0}^000000 个苹果
需要花费 ^FF0000{1}^000000 泽尼。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的商店。
再见！想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough money to
purchase that many Apples.
Please check your zeny or
purchase fewer Apples.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
很抱歉，你的钱不够
购买这么多苹果。
请检查你的泽尼或
减少购买数量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Hmmm, I don't think
you've got enough room in
your inventory to carry this
many Apples. Why don't you free up some of your inventory space?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
唔，我觉得你的
背包空间不足以携带
这么多苹果。要不要先
腾出一些背包空间？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping by
my shop. I hope you enjoy
the flavor of these Apples~!
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的商店。
希望你喜欢这些苹果的
味道~!

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Okay, I'll need
^FF00003 Apples and 1 Empty Bottle^000000
to make 1 Apple Juice for you.
Would you like to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
好的，我需要
^FF00003 个苹果和 1 个空瓶^000000
来为你制作 1 瓶苹果汁。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough materials to
create a bottle of Apple Juice.
Remember, I need 3 Apples
and 1 Empty Bottle to do it.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
很抱歉，你没有足够的
材料来制作一瓶苹果汁。
请记住，我需要 3 个苹果
和 1 个空瓶才能制作。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you,
please wait
just a moment.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
谢谢，
请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Grind grind*
*Grind grind*
*Clang...!*^000000

[Fruitz]
There you go~
I hope you enjoy!
Please feel free to
stop by for your Apple
and Apple Juice needs
at anytime, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
给你啦~
希望你喜欢！
冒险者，需要苹果或
苹果汁的时候，欢迎
随时光临哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的商店。
再见！想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I used to be a wandering
vagabond when, one day,
I took a nap and something
struck my head and awoke
me from my restful slumber.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
我以前是个流浪汉，
直到有一天，我正在
午睡时，有什么东西
砸中了我的头，把我从
甜美的梦中惊醒了。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
It turns out that I was
sleeping beneath an apple
tree and that an apple fell
and hit me on the head.
I was dying of hunger and
was about to eat that Apple...
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
原来我当时正睡在一棵
苹果树下，结果一颗苹果
掉下来砸中了我的头。
我当时正饿得要命，
正打算把那颗苹果吃掉……

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
But suddenly, Kain, my old
friend from the mining days,
asked me to help him around
on the Airship. So I did, and
it was there where I found some
people playing the Dice game.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
但突然间，我以前在矿场
时的老朋友凯恩，请我去
飞空艇上帮帮忙。于是我去了，
就在那里，我发现有人在
玩掷骰子游戏。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I was bored and curious
and ended up wagering that
single Apple in a game of
dice. But for some reason,
I had this incredible lucky
streak. One apple became two...
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
我当时觉得既无聊又好奇，
最后竟然把那颗唯一的苹果
拿去赌骰子了。但不知为何，
我竟然运气爆棚，一直连赢，
一颗苹果变成了两颗……

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Two became four and
before I knew it, I had
cornered the Apple market!
I won so many Apples, I just
started my own business here
on the Airship. Weird, huh?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
两颗变成了四颗，
还没等我反应过来，我就
垄断了苹果市场！我赢了
太多的苹果，于是就在
飞空艇上开了自己的店。
很奇怪吧？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
So Apples are good
for you. They were
certainly very good
to me. Hahahahaah~!
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
所以说，苹果对身体很有好处。
它们对我来说确实非常有益。
哈哈哈哈哈哈~!

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you for
using my shop.
Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的商店。
再见~

[Meltz]
Welcome to Meltz's
Shop where you can
purchase Apples or grind
them to make Apple Juice.

欢迎来到梅尔茨的商店，

and you can buy a maximum

'0' to cancel your order.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
请输入您想要购买的
苹果数量。每个苹果 15 泽尼，
每次最多可购买 500 个。
请输入 '0' 取消订单。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
感谢光临我的商店。再见！
下次想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
You've entered a number
higher than the maximum
value of 500. Please enter
the number of Apples you
wish to purchase again.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
您输入的数字超过了
500 的最大值。请重新输入
您想要购买的苹果数量。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
A total of ^FF0000{0}^000000 Apples
will cost you ^FF0000{1}^000000 zeny.
Would you like to continue?
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
总计 ^FF0000{0}^000000 个苹果
将花费您 ^FF0000{1}^000000 泽尼。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
感谢光临我的商店。再见！
下次想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
I'm sorry, you don't have
enough money with you.
Please check your funds or
purchase less Apples.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
很抱歉，您的持有资金
不足。请检查您的余额
或减少购买数量。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Hmm, I don't think you've
got enough room to carry
this many Apples. You might
want to free up your inventory
space.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
嗯，我觉得您的背包
空间不够携带这么多苹果。
您可能需要清理一下
背包空间。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thanks for stopping by
my shop. I hope you enjoy
the flavor of these Apples~!
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
感谢光临我的商店。
希望您喜欢这些苹果的
味道~!

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Okay, I'll need
^FF00003 Apples and 1 Empty Bottle^000000
to make 1 Apple Juice for you.
Would you like to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
好的，我需要
^FF00003 个苹果和 1 个空瓶^000000
来为您制作 1 瓶苹果汁。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough materials to
create a bottle of Apple Juice.
Remember, I need 3 Apples
and 1 Empty Bottle to do it.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
很抱歉，您没有足够的
材料来制作一瓶苹果汁。
请记住，我需要 3 个苹果
和 1 个空瓶才能制作。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thank you, please wait.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
谢谢，请稍等。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Grind* *Grind*
*Grind* *Grind*
*Clang...!*^000000

[Meltz]
There you go~
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
完成了~~
请下次再来。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
感谢光临我的商店。再见！
下次想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
感谢光临我的商店。再见！
下次想吃苹果当零食时，
随时欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Longitude, 131 degrees east.
Latitude, 37 degrees north.
We're right on course, captain.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
经度，东经131度。
纬度，北纬37度。
我们正按航线行驶，船长。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Looks like a really
cloudy day. Always hard
to navigate when the skies
aren't clear. Guess we'll
need to amp the radar.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
看起来是个阴天。
天空不明朗时，航行总是很困难。
我想我们需要加强雷达了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
The Captain is a good
man and I can't think of
a finer person to command
this ship. Still, he's pretty
tough, a real slave driver.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
船长是个好人，我想不出比他更适合指挥这艘船的人了。
不过，他真的很严厉，简直是个监工。

scripts.text:
[^ff0000Tarlock^000000]
^ff0000Hey...!^000000
^ff0000Less chit-chat^000000
^ff0000and more piloting!^000000

[Pilot]
R-right away, sir!
(See what I mean?)
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
遵、遵命，先生！
（看到我说的了吗？）

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
这身制服
看起来很帅气，
但在飞空艇上穿起来
实在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer.
I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
...
......
从来没有人真正进过这个房间。
而且船长确实是一只驯鹿。
我甚至可以直接脱到只剩内裤。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Oh...! Hello there!
E-e-enjoying your flight?!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
噢...! 您好！
旅、旅、旅途愉快吗？！

scripts.text:
[Dianne]
It's so weird!
I went to visit the
Airship Captain and
all I saw was this
weird reindeer. Oh!
Do you think that...
scripts.translation:
[黛安]
太奇怪了！
我去拜访飞空艇船长，
结果看到的却是一只奇怪的驯鹿。
噢！你觉得那...

scripts.text:
[Mendel]
As I expected, the
in-flight meals are
three star quality at best.
*Harrrumph* I really should
have brought my chef so that
I could enjoy a real meal.
scripts.translation:
[门德尔]
正如我所料，
飞行餐充其量只有三星水准。
*哼* 我真该带上我的厨师，
这样我就能享用真正的美食了。

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
Finally, after five
years of waiting...
I can have my revenge!
scripts.translation:
[剑士 清水]
终于，在等待了五年之后...
我终于可以复仇了！

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
I just...
Have to make sure that
I don't keep missing my
stop. But soon, very soon,
vengeance will be mine!
scripts.translation:
[剑士 清水]
我只是...
得确保自己不要再错过站了。
但很快，很快，复仇终将属于我！

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Welcome to the
^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000.
Would you like to play
a quick typing game?
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
欢迎来到
^ff0000RO 打字挑战^000000。
想要玩个快速打字游戏吗？

scripts.text: Play ^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000
scripts.translation: 开始 ^ff0000RO 打字挑战^000000

scripts.text: Information
scripts.translation: 资讯

scripts.text: View Top Records
scripts.translation: 查看最高纪录

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Okay, we have
a new challenger!
Enter the following
text as quickly as you
can without making any
mistakes! Let's start~!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
好，我们迎来了一位
新的挑战者！
请在不犯任何错误的前提下，
尽可能快地输入以下文本！
我们开始吧~！

[Nils]
Your record is ^ff0000{0} seconds^000000 and
the total letters are {1}.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
你的纪录是 ^ff0000{0} 秒^000000，
总字母数为 {1}。

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Hmmm, this record isn't
humanly possible unless you
copy and paste the whole
sentence. Please play fairly
next time.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
唔，除非你是通过复制粘贴
整句话，否则这个纪录
是不可能由人类达成的。
下次请公平游玩。

scripts.text:
[Nils]
The previous top record was
made by ^0000ff{0}^000000
with the total ^0000ff{1}^000000 letters.
However, ^ff0000{2}^000000,
you made the new top record
this time. Congratulations!
scripts.translation:

之前的最高纪录是由
^0000ff{0}^000000
创造的，总计为
^0000ff{1}^000000
个字符。
但是，^ff0000{2}^000000
这次由你创造了新的最高纪录。
恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Nils]
^0000ff{0}^000000
is the current
record holder with
a letter total of ^0000ff{1}^000000
characters. Try to beat
that record next time~
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
^0000ff{0}^000000
是目前的纪录保持者，
总计字符数为
^0000ff{1}^000000
个。下次试着打破
那个纪录吧~

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Oooh...
I'm sorry, but
you entered the
text incorrectly...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
噢噢...
很抱歉，你输入的
文本有误...

scripts.text:
[Nils]
The ^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000
is a game where you enter
the given text as quickly as you
can. The name of the top player
is recorded for posterity. If you
want fame, here's your chance!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
^ff0000RO打字挑战^000000
是一个比拼速度的游戏，
你需要尽可能快地输入
给定的文本。最高分玩家的名字
将被记录下来以供纪念。
如果你想要名声，机会就在这里！

scripts.text:
[Nils]
I'd just like to let
you know that you type
all the text that you see
in the single input line that
you're given. So don't press
the enter key, just click 'OK.'
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
我只想提醒你一下，
你需要将看到的全部文本
输入到给定的单行输入框中。
所以不要按回车键，只需点击“确定”。

scripts.text:
[Nils]
^0000ff{0}^000000
is the current
record holder with
a letter total of ^0000ff{1}^000000
characters. Try to beat
that record next time~
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
^0000ff{0}^000000
是目前的纪录保持者，
总计字符数为
^0000ff{1}^000000
个。下次试着打破
那个纪录吧~

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Feel free to take on the
^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000
anytime. I'll be here~
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
欢迎随时来挑战
^ff0000RO打字挑战^000000。
我会在这里等你~

scripts.text:
[Clarice]
Hi, I'm Clarice~
How would you like
to wager some Apples
in a friendly game of Dice?
scripts.translation:
[克拉丽丝]
嗨，我是克拉丽丝~
你想不想用苹果
来玩一场友好的掷骰子游戏？

scripts.text: Play Dice Game
scripts.translation: 玩掷骰子游戏

scripts.text: Learn Dice Game Rules
scripts.translation: 了解掷骰子规则

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm up for a game of
dice whenever you feel
like it. Just talk to me if
you ever get hit with the
sudden urge to gamble, kay?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只要你想玩，我随时都可以
陪你玩掷骰子。如果你突然
产生赌博的冲动，记得来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The rules for the Dice game
are pretty simple. First, you
place a bet by wagering Apples.
You can bet a maximum of 50
Apples at a time. To keep things
legal, I can only accept Apples.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
掷骰子游戏的规则非常简单。
首先，你通过下注苹果来参与。
每次最多可以下注 50 个苹果。
为了合法合规，我只能接受苹果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But hey, if all that zeny
is burning a hole in your
pocket, head over to Fruitz
and you can buy as many
Apples as you want, playah~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，如果你兜里的泽尼
多到没处花，可以去弗鲁茨
那里买你想买的苹果，伙计~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, we begin with me
rolling two 6-sided dice.
When it's your turn, you'll
roll two 6-sided dice. After
that, both of us will have the
option of rolling a third die.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，由我先掷两个六面骰子。
轮到你时，你也会掷两个六面骰子。
之后，我们双方都可以选择
是否掷第三个骰子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now here's the important
thing. If your total is higher
than 12, you'll bust, meaning
that you lose. Otherwise, the
person with the higher total
is the winner. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在是重点。
如果你的点数总和超过 12，
你就爆了，也就是输了。
否则，点数总和较高的人获胜。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, you'll be the first
to decide whether or not
you'll roll the third die. Then,
depending on your result, I'll
roll my third die... Or maybe not.
scripts.translation:
[{0}] 首先由你决定 是否要掷第三个骰子。 然后，根据你的结果， 我会决定是否掷我的第三个骰子...
也许不掷也说不定。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When you win, you'll
receive twice as many
Apples as you wagered.
But if we happen to tie, you
get the Apples that you bet
returned to you. Fair, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当你获胜时，你将获得
两倍于下注数量的苹果。
但如果我们平局，
你下注的苹果会退还给你。
很公平，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ooh, so you'll play with
me? Great! How many
Apples would you like to bet?
Remember, you can wager
up to 50 Apples. If you'd like
to cancel, please enter '0'.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢，所以你要和我玩吗？
太棒了！你想下注多少个
苹果？请记住，你最多可以
下注 50 个苹果。如果你想
取消，请输入“0”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Changed your mind?
I understand. Well then,
I hope we can play sometime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
改变主意了？
我理解。那么，
希望以后有机会能一起玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can't bet more than
50 Apples. Remember, we
need to keep these stakes
reasonable. Please enter
a value no greater than 50.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不能下注超过
50 个苹果。请记住，
我们需要保持赌注在合理范围内。
请输入不大于 50 的数值。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you'll be
betting ^FF0000{1}^000000 Apples.
Is that right?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mm, made a mistake?
Alright, please enter the
number of Apples you
wish to place in this bet
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，弄错了吗？
好吧，请输入您想要
投入本次赌局的
苹果数量。

scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but you
don't seem to have
enough Apples for this
bet... You can't gamble
if you can't play, you know.
scripts.translation:
很抱歉，您似乎没有
足够的苹果来进行
这次赌局……
没本钱可不能赌博哦。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good!
Now we can start
this game! I'll roll first~
^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好！
现在我们可以开始游戏了！
我先来掷骰子~
^3355FF*骰子滚动声*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
Cast Dice.
scripts.translation: 掷骰子

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[{0}]
Currently my total is ^0000FF{1}^000000 and ^FF0000{2}^000000, your total is ^FF0000{3}^000000. We are making an even game. Would you like to cast dice again?

[{0}]
Currently my total is ^0000FF{1}^000000 and ^FF0000{2}^000000, your total is ^FF0000{3}^000000. ^FF0000{4}^000000, you are currently winning this game. Would you like to cast dice again?

[{0}]
Currently my total is ^0000FF{1}^000000 and ^FF0000{2}^000000, your total is ^FF0000{3}^000000. I am winning this game. Would you like to cast dice again?
Cast dice.
scripts.translation: 掷骰子

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. You lost this game. I am sorry but please try again.

[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. Even though you casted dice again, still your total is smaller than mine. You lost the game. I am sorry and please try again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000，你掷出了 ^FF0000{2}^000000，总计为 ^FF0000{3}^000000。
虽然你再次掷了骰子，但你的总计还是比我的小。你输了。很抱歉，请下次再试吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. I don't want to take any risk, let's end this game in a draw. Let's play again some other time~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000，你掷出了 ^FF0000{2}^000000，总计为 ^FF0000{3}^000000。
我不想冒任何风险，我们就以平局结束这场游戏吧。下次再玩吧~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
Let me cast the dice again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。
让我再次掷骰子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. Now it is my turn.

[{0}]
I see, you don't want to take risk of losing this game. Neither do I, let's end this game in a draw. Let's play again some other time~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了，你不想承担输掉游戏的风险。我也不想，我们就以平局结束这场游戏吧。下次再玩吧~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It couldn't hurt to try.
Well, I win this time.
I'm sorry, let's try play
again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
试一下也没什么损失。
好吧，这次我赢了。
很抱歉，我们改天再玩吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see, you don't want to take risk of losing the game. Okay, let me cast dice again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了，你不想承担输掉游戏的风险。好吧，让我再次掷骰子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
Let me cast the dice again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。
让我再次掷骰子。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. I lost this game since my total exceeded 12. Let me give you my apples. Congratulations, that was a great game.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得到了 ^0000FF{1}^000000，现在的总计是 ^0000FF{2}^000000。因为总计超过了12，我输了这场游戏。把我的苹果都给你吧。恭喜，这是一场精彩的对局。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. With total ^FF0000{3}^000000 you won this game, ^FF0000{4}^000000. Let me give you my apples. It was a great game and I hope we will play again some other time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得到了 ^0000FF{1}^000000，现在的总计是 ^0000FF{2}^000000。凭借 ^FF0000{3}^000000 的总计，你赢得了这场游戏，^FF0000{4}^000000。把我的苹果都给你吧。这是一场精彩的对局，希望下次还能和你一起玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. With total ^FF0000{3}^000000 this game came out even, ^FF0000{4}^000000. Let me give you your apple back. It was a great game and I hope we will play again some other time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得到了 ^0000FF{1}^000000，现在的总计是 ^0000FF{2}^000000。凭借 ^FF0000{3}^000000 的总计，这场游戏打平了，^FF0000{4}^000000。把你的苹果还给你。这是一场精彩的对局，希望下次还能和你一起玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. With total ^FF0000{3}^000000 you lost this game, ^FF0000{4}^000000. I am sorry but please try again.
